input_rule: The caller supplies one closed ArgumentBinding only. It supplies no selector, query text, relation, projection, aggregation, ordering, bounds, universe, rights state, release identity, or result field.
universe_rule: The kernel eagerly materializes the complete Cartesian product in registered parameter order and registered domain-member order. Rights refusal changes answerability but never removes a binding from the denominator.
claim_boundary: Admission establishes only that one synthetic question was drawn from one registered template and closed registered domains, and that the complete finite question universe and requested position were deterministically materialized from pinned committed governance bytes. It does not establish source truth, question quality, result accuracy, publication approval, production authentication, or absence of caller preference. It makes selective publication visible, not impossible.
